name: Pendry West Hollywood
insider_take: This rooftop sanctuary sits above the legendary Sunset Strip, where rock history meets Hollywood glamour in the most stylish way possible.
whats_special: The hotel's rooftop pool deck offers unobstructed views of the Hollywood Hills and downtown LA skyline, while occupying the same strip where iconic venues like the Whisky a Go Go and Rainbow Bar & Grill launched countless music careers. The building's location puts you steps from the historic Sunset Tower, once home to Hollywood legends like John Wayne and Frank Sinatra.
pro_tip: Book dinner at Merois for sunset hour – the restaurant's floor-to-ceiling windows perfectly frame the nightly light show over the city, and you'll often spot celebrities at neighboring tables.
dont_miss: The Wolfgang Puck at Merois experience and cocktails at the rooftop pool bar during golden hour. Take a short walk to catch a show at the legendary Comedy Store or browse the vintage rock memorabilia at Rainbow Bar & Grill, both within two blocks of the hotel.
pros: Prime Sunset Strip location with vibrant nightlife access
Modern luxury design with contemporary amenities
Exceptional service and attention to detail
cons: Busy urban location with potential street noise
